verdict.rationale: EFTPS is a payment service, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no such reference: the only documented software channel is the downloadable Batch Provider Software, not an API, and probes for OpenAPI or Swagger specs at every candidate path returned 404. There is no evidence of an interactive API reference or runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
